title: Vesper and the Extraction
author: Ansel Amberdale
blurb: Hazel Zhou, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
